thread:
mira.design: Quick feedback request: floating quickstart chip for first-run flow pushed to staging. URL: https://staging.console.redwood-inference.com/onboard/quickstart-chip :mag:
lee_frontend: Saw it. Animation looks good. Keyboard focus currently goes behind header on expand. Repro: tab -> chip -> press enter -> focus jumps to end of page.
sam_access: A11y checklist: 1) chip must be a real <button>, 2) on expand focus should move to first actionable control, 3) include visually hidden descriptive text like 'Opens sample projects in current workspace'. Also color contrast for chip label is 3.4:1; needs 4.5:1 or larger text.
alex_pm: Metric reminder: prioritize api-key creation inside flow. If the chip hides the key step, we lose conversions. devon, can you ensure sample-open event includes variant id and user cohort?
devon_devex: Yep. planning events: onboard.chip_open, onboard.sample_launch, onboard.api_key_created. Payload: {user_id, variant, elapsed_ms}.
lee_frontend: I'll change the chip from div to button and implement focus restore on close. Plan to use a simple lastFocusedEl.focus() on dismiss.
qa-bot: QA finding: on iOS Safari the expansion causes layout jump and checklist overlaps the header. Filing ticket QA-317.
mira.design: Copy options for chip label (short): 'Try sample', 'Run sample', 'Open quickstarts'. Vote?
alex_pm: 'Try sample' wins.
sam_access: Also add non-color completed state indicator (icon + text) for step completion.
mira.design: Okay I'll update mocks and upload to design-assets. Once fixes clear QA let's A/B test chip vs persistent rail vs checklist for 14 days.
lee_frontend: Quick code sketch for focus restore:
```
const prev = document.activeElement;
openChip();
firstAction.focus();
closeChip(() => prev && prev.focus());
```
I'll include robust fallback.
mira.design: Thanks, team. Tag me on PR for copy review. :thumbsup:
